ctaHeading: Ready to Transform Your Garden in Hoppers Crossing?
aboutText: Based in Hoppers Crossing, Creative Gardens has been delivering exceptional landscaping services to Melbourne's west. Our team specialises in synthetic turf installation, retaining walls, garden makeovers, and custom landscaping for homes and businesses. We are passionate about creating beautiful outdoor spaces, with expertise in irrigation systems and water features. Whether it's a new home landscape or a school maintenance project, we bring creativity and quality to every job.
servicesText: At Creative Gardens, we offer comprehensive landscaping solutions from design to installation. Our services include turf laying, wall construction, and complete garden transformations, all customised for Hoppers Crossing properties.
